name: issuarr
description: Issuarr automatically finds, downloads, renames, tags and organizes your comic books (cbz and cbr) from Usenet, torrents and GetComics. It is a free, open-source successor to Mylar3 and a drop-in replacement for the linuxserver/mylar3 image: point Appdata at your old mylar3 folder and your settings and database carry over. For the best database performance keep Appdata on a pool or disk path (for example /mnt/cache/appdata/issuarr) rather than /mnt/user, unless the appdata share is exclusive to a pool. See https://issuarr.github.io/issuarr/Unraid/

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Settings, database and cover cache (kept in the mylar subfolder). Coming from Mylar3, use your old mylar3 appdata folder. A pool or disk path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/issuarr lets the database use its faster WAL mode.

paths.name: Comics
paths.description: Your comic library. Set Settings > General > Comic folder to /comics. Coming from Mylar3, keep the same container path as before.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: The folder where your download clients put finished downloads. Use the same container path your download client uses.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Port for the Issuarr web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns your files (99 is nobody on Unraid).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns your files (100 is users on Unraid).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File permission mask for new files.
